name: Ayush Singh
role: Building reliable distributed systems, streaming data infrastructure, and backend platforms.

lines: I enjoy designing systems that continue to work under failure.
I turn ideas into production-grade systems.

about_me.text: I build systems that are reliable, scalable and observable. My interests lie in distributed systems, streaming pipelines, backend platforms and automation.
about_me.exploring: System Design, Cloud, and High Performance Systems
about_me.fun_fact: I drink coffee and write code. Repeat.

featured_projects.name: Market Stream Ingestion Engine
featured_projects.desc: Real-time order-book ingestion on Redpanda (Kafka) with PySpark Structured Streaming and Delta Lake: strict schema validation, DLQ routing and VWAP over tumbling windows.

featured_projects.name: Notification Queue Service
featured_projects.desc: Fault-tolerant Go message broker with per-key ordering, persistence, consumer groups, acks and exactly-once semantics (simulated), plus a load generator and monitoring stack.

featured_projects.name: Financial Market Lakehouse
featured_projects.desc: Medallion-architecture (Bronze to Gold) market data platform: Airflow orchestration, a DuckDB warehouse, dbt models and Great Expectations quality gates, all reproducible locally.

featured_projects.name: Cost & Carbon-Aware LLM Gateway
featured_projects.desc: LLM gateway with semantic caching (Redis exact-match plus Milvus similarity), multi-provider failover and cost-aware routing, backed by an offline benchmark and routing pipeline.

featured_projects.name: Edge-Cloud Predictive Maintenance
featured_projects.desc: Research-backed smart-factory framework: CNN-LSTM remaining-useful-life estimation (RMSE 57.29), a SimPy digital twin and a Flutter dashboard for routing-aware what-if analysis.

upcoming_projects.name: Carbon-Aware LLM Scheduling
upcoming_projects.desc: promoting the mock carbon signal to real grid intensity data
